m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: <ITALICS>Squeel! Squeel! </ITALICS>
Were they supposed to be a threat? Was it because they were dangerous or disgusting? Either way, I wasn't bothered.
Hohoho! That was merely a warm-up, to prime the audience for the real action. In the next room, you'll battle my favorite Bounty Hunter...
There will be a substantial reward for this, Bounty Hunter. You are free to use any methods necessary, but I want them alive. No disintegrations.
As you wish.
Hello, Wizard. I get a bonus today - Ali Baboon's reward for defeating you, and one from Kobra Kommander when I bring you back to Istanboa.
Well isn't this one confident? He's just another Boa. I'd wager we could take him even if we were blind. Let's see how tough he really is.
Enough! Face it, Bounty Hunter. You failed.
We had a deal. You said I'd get to capture my quarry either way.
You may take the Wizard back to Istanboa only after the Underden Event is complete. There remains the Rain Core to be faced.
The Wizard's no good to me dead.
The Wizard will not be permanently damaged. Ali Baboon will compensate you if the Wizard dies.
Well, look at that. Doesn't seem so bad - just a little rain cloud... kinda cute, really.
Cute? After he's done, you will find a new definition of pain and suffering, as you are slowly rained on over a thousand years...
On second thought, let's pass on that, huh? I prefer sunny days, don't you, Wizard? Yes, let's win this one.
How dare you defeat my Rain Core? You will suffer for this outrage... er... if you're smart, you'll leave the Thieves Den and never return!
Did you hear that? I think I detected a note of fear in his voice. This is good. We've got him on the defensive. Let's go.
Oh look, the Dromel Dance Squad is still here. Good to see a friendly face, isn't it? Let's ask where Ali Baboon went.
Thank the sands you two are all right. I would feel horrible if something happened after I promised to smuggle you in safely.
My main concern... I just hope he doesn't leave us down here to rot. I've done enough of that, thank you very much.
Welcome to the Underden, my friends. Ali Baboon and his guests appreciate your participation in this exciting sporting event.
A gauntlet of combatants awaits you in the adjoining chambers - a test of your prowess. You should know, however, that victory is impossible.
Whatever. Are you trying to make us scared? Nice try! I say he's underestimating us. They always do, don't they?
I'm afraid not, my bony friend. You will suffer humiliating defeat here, but it should be a terrific show! With that, let the games begin...!
